Respiratory infections peak every winter, and HMPV is just one of many culprits. 

The world isn’t under siege from a new pandemic: just grappling with the natural ebb and flow of seasonal illness.

If you had heard whispers of a new health scare, what would you want to feel when the story unfolded?

Reassured? Informed? Empowered to separate fact from fear?

Stay informed. Stay calm. Stay connected to the truth.
